description: This Java abstract class 'AbstractWorkbookPopulator' provides utility methods to populate Excel workbooks with data such as integers, longs, strings, booleans, doubles, dates, and BigDecimals, as well as methods to set lookup tables for offices, clients, and groups, and to sanitize sheet names. It is part of a bulk import mechanism in the Fineract project, dealing with creating or populating Excel files based on organizational data.

classes.name: AbstractWorkbookPopulator
classes.description: An abstract class providing utility methods to populate Excel workbooks with organizational data and define lookup tables, used as part of the bulk import process in the Fineract system.

methods.name: writeInt
